description: Add a screenshot, reference file or other asset from this machine to a folder. Use a real file path you can read; the bytes are uploaded directly, not copied into a guide. Images, PDF, ZIP and text are accepted up to 10 MB.

file.description: path to the file on this machine

folder.description: folder id returned by create_folder or list_folders

name.description: label in the folder; defaults to the filename

name: add_folder_asset
title: Add file to project folder
